name: It Came From The Orgone Chamber
source:
BETH: I felt like if this trip went well, somehow, it would change my regard within the family, with my father...

MARK: 「I'm just humouring your dad, trying to find stuff in common with him, y'know.」

WILLIAM: 「You see, orgone is connected to your sense and, and reality, of vigour...」 

[From [url=https://dominoclub.itch.io/it-came-from-the-orgone-chamber]Itch.io[/url]]
